rounds.prompt: How many olives does it take to fill a bottle of olive oil (1 liter, 34 oz)?
rounds.source: International Olive Council production costs study, which puts average mill yield near 18%

rounds.prompt: How many pizza boxes would you have to stack to reach the top of the Leaning Tower of Pisa?
rounds.source: Opera della Primaziale Pisana, the body that manages the tower

rounds.prompt: How many people work as flight attendants worldwide?
rounds.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics count scaled by IATA and BTS passenger totals; no body publishes a worldwide figure
